sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.1579 of 2025 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M., Rairangpur arising out of Jamda P.S. Case No.121 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/ 313/ 506/ 294/ 34 of IPC.
3.
Learned counsel for the Petitioner undertakes to implead the informant as Opposite Party No.2.
Consolidated cause title be filed by 09.01.2026.

4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner is requested to serve an extra copy of the brief on the learned counsel for the State by 09.01.2026, who is requested to serve the same on the informant (Opposite Party No.2) through the I.O. indicating that the matter shall be taken up on 18.02.2026.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
6. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
In the event extra is not served on the learned counsel for the State, as directed, the interim order shall stand vacated.
7. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
